Hi Claire - great to chat yesterday. Below is a concise post-call recap with benchmarking and next steps.

Call recap / assumptions:
- Workload: ~90% generation, 10% embeddings.
- Starting volume: 200M tokens/mo; expected to grow to ~1B tokens/mo within 6-9 months.
- Latency SLOs: 200-400ms p95 (you mentioned conversational UX needs).

High-level target $/1M tokens (illustrative, pre-discount):
- Redwood (hosted): $12-18 per 1M tokens at 200M/mo tier. With committed volume (>=1B/mo) and Dedicated options, effective $/1M can drop to $8-12.
- OpenAI (public pricing for similar gen models): typically $18-28 per 1M tokens depending on model class and context window.
- Anthropic (Claude-class hosted): roughly $16-24 per 1M tokens in comparable tiers.
- Other hosts (self-hosted or open-model managed providers): wide range $6-20 per 1M depending on model variant, quantization, and pooling.

Notes on unit economics:
- Caching/prefixing: for conversational assistants with repeated prompts, effective token spend can drop by ~15-40% depending on cache hit rates.
- Batching & KV cache reuse (at runtime): reduces GPU token cost for high-throughput workloads, often shifting the marginal cost curve down by 10-30%.
- Dedicated capacity: fixed-cost committed pools make $/1M projections predictable; we can model a blended rate combining committed + burst usage.

Quick estimate for your projected 200M tokens/mo (mix: 90% gen / 10% embeddings):
- Redwood hosted (no commit): at $15 per 1M -> 200 * $15 = $3,000/month. Note: your stated $30k- $50k budget suggests higher token counts or larger context/response sizes.

Clarification: Typical enterprise pricing is quoted per 1M tokens; so 200M * $15/1M = $3,000. If your team expects $30k- $50k/month, that suggests either higher token counts (e.g., 2-3B tokens) or heavier prompt/response sizes.

Example scenarios:
- If you meant 200M input+output tokens per day -> monthly ~6B tokens -> at $12/1M = ~$72,000/mo.
- If monthly 200M tokens total: at Redwood $12/1M = $2,400/mo; at OpenAI $20/1M = $4,000/mo.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm whether your 200M figure is monthly or monthly-per-day (common confusion).
2) I'll attach a short pricing sheet showing tiered examples and a sample mutual action plan (MAP) for committed volume.
3) If you want, we can model a target blended $/1M for a 6- and 12-month ramp (I can run 2 scenarios).

Attached: Redwood_pricing_v1.pdf (PDF, 42KB), token_model_comparison.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB), Mutual_Action_Plan.docx (DOCX, 34KB)

Happy to hop on a 30-min call this week with procurement/finance to walk numbers. What time works?

Thanks,
